prompt:
# Subject Merge Fine Clustering

## Quick Start

Inside one topic area, create tight candidate clusters that are worth a later same-concept decision. Use only the provided candidate cards.

## Identity Filter

Cluster candidates only when they might be the same teachable idea at the same level, testable with the same question.

Do not cluster just because candidates share a keyword. Keep candidates separate when one adds implementation, math, limitation, application, deeper mechanism, tool-specific behavior, or a broader/narrower student action.

Doubt means singleton. Under-clustering is safer than sending unrelated candidates to merge evaluation.

## Output

Return one JSON object only:

```json
{
  "clusters": [
    {
      "id": "cluster_001",
      "label": "Short candidate cluster",
      "rationale": "Why these candidates may share concept identity.",
      "candidate_ids": ["candidate-id"]
    }
  ]
}
```

## Self-Check

- Every input candidate ID appears exactly once.
- Each non-singleton cluster has a plausible same-concept reason.
- Implementation, limitation, application, math, and deeper-revisit candidates were not grouped with definitions just because labels overlap.
- Mixed-language same-level candidates were clustered when their teachable idea matches.
- No web search or external knowledge was used.

area.label: Gensim for Vector Space Models
area.rationale: Gensim-specific: corpus, dictionary, doc2bow, TF-IDF model, similarity queries, and training Word2Vec.

candidates.label: Documento, Corpus e Streaming no Gensim
candidates.description: No Gensim, um documento é uma sequência de texto (str), um corpus é uma coleção de documentos para treinamento não supervisionado, e o streaming permite processar grandes corpora sem carregar tudo em memória.
coverage_criteria: Defina documento e corpus no Gensim.
Explique como o Gensim lida com grandes conjuntos de dados usando streaming.

candidates.label: Vetores Esparsos no Gensim
candidates.description: Vetores no Gensim representam documentos como bag-of-words esparsas, onde cada feature é um contador de palavra, omitindo zeros para economia de memória.
coverage_criteria: Explique o que é um vetor esparso no Gensim.

candidates.label: Modelos no Gensim como Transformações
candidates.description: Um modelo no Gensim aprende uma transformação entre espaços vetoriais (ex.: BOW para TF-IDF) a partir de um corpus de treinamento e pode ser aplicado a novos documentos.
coverage_criteria: Defina o papel de um modelo no Gensim.
Dê um exemplo de transformação que um modelo pode realizar.

candidates.label: Dicionário Gensim e Vetorização com doc2bow
candidates.description: A classe Dictionary mapeia cada palavra do corpus para um ID inteiro único, e o método doc2bow converte documentos tokenizados em vetores bag-of-words.
coverage_criteria: Explique o propósito de um Dictionary no Gensim.
Use um dicionário para converter um texto curto em um vetor BOW.

candidates.label: Modelo TF-IDF no Gensim
candidates.description: O modelo TF-IDF transforma vetores bag-of-words ponderando as frequências dos termos pela inversa da frequência nos documentos, dando menos peso a palavras comuns e mais a palavras raras.
coverage_criteria: Explique o efeito do TF-IDF sobre os pesos das palavras.
Compare os pesos de palavras frequentes e raras após aplicar TF-IDF.

candidates.label: Similarity Queries with Gensim
candidates.description: After transforming a corpus with a model (e.g., TF-IDF), Gensim can compute similarity scores between a query document and all documents in the corpus, enabling search and clustering.
coverage_criteria: Explain how to perform a similarity query in Gensim.
Interpret similarity scores from a given output.
Sort documents by relevance using similarity scores.

candidates.label: Gensim Library and Text Preprocessing
candidates.description: Gensim is an open-source NLP library providing tools for text preprocessing and analysis. Key preprocessing steps include tokenizing text with simple_preprocess() or tokenize(), and building a vocabulary with gensim.corpora.Dictionary(), which maps tokens to integer IDs for model training.
coverage_criteria: Explain that Gensim is a Python library for NLP with origins in topic modeling.
Use simple_preprocess() to tokenize text and filter by length.
Create a Dictionary from tokenized documents and explain its role.

candidates.label: Training Word2Vec Models with Gensim
candidates.description: Gensim's Word2Vec class trains word embeddings on preprocessed sentences. Key parameters (e.g., min_count, size, sg, window, hs, negative) control the training, and the resulting model can be saved and loaded for later use.
coverage_criteria: Instantiate a Word2Vec model with a list of tokenized sentences and basic parameters.
List at least four training parameters and explain their effects.
Save and load a trained Word2Vec model using gensim.save() and gensim.load().

candidate_assignment_rule: Cluster only. Every input candidate ID must appear exactly once across clusters. Prefer tight clusters; topic overlap alone is not a cluster.

web_access_policy.instruction: Do not use web search or open URLs. Use only the provided candidate cards.
